_about: The poses every live companion needs (AGENTS.md, Companion art). A new companion goes live only with all of them, and a PR adding a pose here draws it for every live companion; CI checks that with `xtask art-coverage --since`. Until every live companion has every pose (AnkiQuest/AnkiQuest-Server#57), a missing extension shows its fallback, which is a core pose or another extension that eventually reaches one; then the fallbacks are removed.
